title: Edmonton to host 2028 Grey Cup

blocks.text: The Edmonton Elks and the Canadian Football League announced that the 2028 Grey Cup will be held in Edmonton. The last time Commonwealth Stadium hosted a Grey Cup was in 2018, when the Calgary Stampeders beat the Ottawa Redblacks 27-16.
Commonwealth Stadium last hosted the Grey Cup in 2018
The 2028 Grey Cup is coming to Edmonton.
The Edmonton Elks, the winners of this year's championship, and the Canadian Football League made the announcement Wednesday in Edmonton.
The 115th Grey Cup game will be played at Commonwealth Stadium.
The last time Commonwealth Stadium hosted the Grey Cup was in 2018, when the Calgary Stampeders beat the Ottawa Redblacks 27-16.

While Edmonton has won 15 Grey Cups, none of them have been won at Commonwealth Stadium. Their closest opportunity was in 2002, when the team lost 25-16 to the Montreal Alouettes in front of a spillover crowd of 62,531.
The announcement comes just over a week after the Elks won the 113th Grey Cup game in Calgary, securing the club's 15th championship in franchise history and its first Grey Cup win in 11 years.
Saskatchewan is set to host the 2027 Grey Cup game at Mosaic Stadium in Regina.
